summary: IDF struck Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon after intercepting two explosive drones near Ali Taher ridge, with Lebanese media reporting Ghandour Hospital in Nabatieh al-Fawqa destroyed. IRGC Navy and US forces exchanged attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman, with four Iranian-linked tankers hit. Iranian parliament security spokesman declared an "existential war" with the United States while asserting a defensive posture.

sections.executive_summary: IDF struck Hezbollah targets in southern Lebanon after intercepting two explosive drones near Ali Taher ridge, with Lebanese media reporting Ghandour Hospital in Nabatieh al-Fawqa destroyed. IRGC Navy and US forces exchanged attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman, with four Iranian-linked tankers hit. Iranian parliament security spokesman declared an "existential war" with the United States while asserting a defensive posture.

points: IRGC Navy announced it targeted three tankers passing through unauthorized routes in the Strait of Hormuz and three US vessels in other areas, while confirming US forces attacked three Iranian tankers causing damage; IRGC political deputy Ali Mohammadi stated US attacks created no disruption to their supervision and imposition of will in the region (Source: @VahidOnline/78246)

Iranian armed forces commander Ali Abdollahi rejected US surrender demands as an illusion that will never materialize, framing the confrontation as a test of Iranian resolve (Source: @kianmeli1/91585, @asafroz/53140)

Parliament national security committee spokesman told Al Jazeera Iran is in a defensive state not offensive against American escalation, adheres to the memorandum of understanding but Washington acts to escalate, and characterized the situation as an existential war against the United States (Source: @New_security8200/203631)
TankerTrackers reported a fourth Iranian-linked tanker hit in Gulf of Oman waters over the past few days, bringing the total targeted tankers to four (Source: @kianmeli1/91579)

IDF attacked Hezbollah terrorists and infrastructure in southern Lebanon in response to two explosive drones launched at forces in the security zone; the drones were intercepted with no casualties reported (Source: @idf_telegram/25065, @almogboker78/18140)

Large-scale pre-planned drill led by Division 80 begins Monday in Eilat and the Arava, simulating multi-front surprise attack scenarios across air, sea, and land with emphasis on protecting communities and Eilat city, involving IDF, police, and MDA cooperation (Source: @pkpoi/143860, @manniefabian/59103)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation on three fronts — Israel-Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, US-Iran tanker warfare in the Strait of Hormuz, and continued Israel-Hamas operations in Gaza — indicates a coordinated pressure campaign. Iran's declaration of "existential war" while maintaining defensive posture suggests calculated escalation management. The destruction of Ghandour Hospital, even if empty, raises humanitarian law concerns and potential for broader international condemnation. The Eilat drill signals Israeli preparation for multi-front conflict expansion.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese media and Press TV frame Israeli strikes as aggression and violations of humanitarian law, highlighting hospital destruction. Iranian official rhetoric emphasizes resistance and rejection of US surrender demands while IRGC Navy demonstrates continued freedom of action in the Strait. Hamas political leadership rejects external pressure on Gaza's governance. Yemen's Armed Forces maintain independent missile operations against Saudi-backed forces. No Gulf state diplomatic initiatives evident in the data.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Ali Taher ridge emerges as a consistent friction point for Hezbollah drone operations against IDF forces. TankerTrackers' open-source confirmation of four Iranian-linked tanker hits in days suggests sustained maritime interdiction campaign. The IDF's immediate acknowledgment of drone interceptions and retaliatory strikes indicates shortened decision cycles. The Eilat drill's scope — Division 80, multi-domain, inter-agency — implies operational concept validation for southern front contingencies. Iranian parliament's "existential war" language marks a rhetorical threshold.
